S.FORM: ka sitsuayan neka pumuqan, neka ngilu, neka sengsengan; sa masepeɫ itjen.
S.PHON: ka siʦuajan nəka pumuqan nəka ŋiɭu nəka səŋsəŋan sa masəpəʎ icən
S.FORM: ka sicuayan neka pumuqan, neka ngilu, neka sengsengan; sa masepelj itjen.
S.PHON: ka siʦuajan nəka pumuqan nəka ŋiɣu nəka səŋsəŋan sa masəpəʎ icən
S.TRANSL: Once upon a time there were no ulcers, no pain, no work, and we were bored.

S.FORM: "kemuda itjen sa kaqati a tja sengsengan?" aya a maɫavar.
S.PHON: kəmuda icən sa kaqati a ca səŋsəŋanʔ aja a maʎavar
S.FORM: "kemuda itjen sa kaqati a tja sengsengan?" aya a maljavar.
S.PHON: kəmuda icən sa kaqati a ca səŋsəŋanʔ aja a maʎavaR
S.TRANSL: "What shall we do to make work for ourselves?" they said to one another.

S.FORM: "tjamanguaq a tji navenli tua ngilu tua pumuqan, sa tja tavaɫan a pitju tja kula.
S.PHON: camaŋuaq a ci navənɭi tua ŋiɭu tua pumuqan sa ca tavaʎan a picu ca kuɭa
S.FORM: "tjamanguaq a tji navenli tua ngilu tua pumuqan, sa tja tavaljan a pitju tja kula.
S.PHON: camaŋuaq a ci navənɣi tua ŋiɣu tua pumuqan sa ca tavaʎan a picu ca kuɣa
S.TRANSL: "We would be better off to buy some pain and ulcers, and plant them in our legs.

S.FORM: nu lemutud kitjen a masusepeɫan," aya a maɫavar.
S.PHON: nu ɭəmutud kicən a masusəpəʎan aja a maʎavar
S.FORM: nu lemutud kitjen a masusepeljan," aya a maljavar.
S.PHON: nu ɣəmutud kicən a masusəpəʎan aja a maʎavaR
S.TRANSL: When they are painful, we won't feel bored," they said to one another.

S.FORM: qau venli, sa tavaɫan a pitju kula, aya.
S.PHON: qau vənɭi sa tavaʎan a picu kuɭa aja
S.FORM: qau venli, sa tavaljan a pitju kula, aya.
S.PHON: qau vənɣi sa tavaʎan a picu kuɣa aja
S.TRANSL: So they bought them and planted them in their legs, it is said.

S.FORM: avanu sika izua nua pumuqan nua ngilu tutsu.
S.PHON: avanu sika izua nua pumuqan nua ŋiɭu tuʦu
S.FORM: avanu sika izua nua pumuqan nua ngilu tucu.
S.PHON: avanu sika izua nua pumuqan nua ŋiɣu tuʦu
S.TRANSL: That's why there are ulcers and pain now.

S.FORM: saka navenli ti Tsuluɫ kati Taupili, aya a tjautsikel a masi tsuay.
S.PHON: saka navənɭi ti ʦuɭuʎ kati taupiɭi aja a cauʦikəɭ a masi ʦuaj
S.FORM: saka navenli ti Cululj kati Taupili, aya a tjaucikel a masi cuay.
S.PHON: saka navənɣi ti ʦuɣuʎ kati taupiɣi aja a cauʦikəɣ a masi ʦuaj
S.TRANSL: It was the Tsuluɫ and Taupili families that bought them, according to the old story.
